ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity cream/white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe exhibits a dominant high-intensity field with dark-grey pigmentation along the trailing edge and midline. The right lobe contains a large, contiguous low-intensity dark blob extending from the peduncle into the center, surrounded by white/cream patches at the distal tip and along the lower trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) continuous across both lobes, with significant pixel-depth variations on the medial-to-distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized circular dark clusters visible within the white field of the right lobe distal section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct dark, unaligned rake marks (linear pixel disruptions) crossing the white surfaces of both lobes, most prominent on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/loss of tissue at the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as a non-symmetrical indentation compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive ochre-colored (tan/brown) pixel clusters indicating biological staining across the high-intensity cream regions of both fluke lobes.
